metrics.name: Length of Stay (LOS)
metrics.definition: The number of days a patient was in the hospital.

metrics.name: Recognized Revenue
metrics.definition: Only bills that have been marked as 'Paid' are considered realized revenue.

metrics.name: Bed Occupancy Rate
metrics.definition: The ratio of currently admitted patients to the total number of available beds across all rooms.

metrics.name: Patient Age
metrics.definition: Calculated dynamically using the Date_Of_Birth relative to the current date.

common_gotchas.solution: Always filter using Status = 'Admitted' AND Discharge_Date IS NULL to find current patients.
Total_Amount is the sum of Insurance_Covered and Patient_Owed. To find outstanding debt, look at Patient_Owed where Status != 'Paid'.
Use the Is_Abnormal BOOLEAN column to quickly find problematic lab results instead of parsing the Result_Value string.
Outpatients have an Admission_ID that is NULL in the Billing and Appointments tables. Inpatients have an Admission_ID that is NOT NULL.
